name: Salaria
tagline: Payroll built for the person actually cutting the checks on set.
positioning: Salaria runs payroll for indie films, commercials, and one-person production companies — timecards, W-2s, and residuals without a payroll department.

hero.h1: Pay your crew like a real studio, without becoming one.
hero.sub: Salaria turns crew deal memos into signed timecards, tax forms, and same-week payouts. Built for the director who is also the accountant, the producer, and the person answering emails at 1am.

features.title: Deal memo to paycheck
features.description: Import a crew deal memo and Salaria builds the pay rules — daily rate, kit fee, overtime, meal penalties — so the timecard math is done before you ever open a spreadsheet.

features.title: Timecards from the field
features.description: Your gaffer clocks in from a phone on location. You approve from the couch. No paper start slips, no photographing a clipboard at wrap.

features.title: Tax forms that just exist
features.description: W-2s, 1099s, and state filings generate automatically at year end. Each crew member gets their forms in one link, not a frantic January email chain.

features.title: Residuals you can track
features.description: Log participation and deferred pay per project, so when a short finally sells you know exactly who is owed what — down to the PA who stayed late.

features.title: One payout, many gigs
features.description: Run a two-day commercial and a six-week feature from the same account. Every project keeps its own budget, crew, and paper trail.

features.title: Made for one operator
features.description: No seats to buy, no HR module to configure. Salaria assumes you are the entire back office and hides everything you don't need.

testimonials.quote: I shot a 12-day feature with a crew of nine and did payroll from my hotel room. The W-2s went out in January and nobody emailed me confused. That has literally never happened before.
testimonials.name: Devon Marsh

testimonials.quote: We run three or four branded shorts a month. Salaria keeps each one's crew and rates separate, so I'm not reverse-engineering who worked which day at the end of the quarter.
testimonials.name: Priya Anand

testimonials.quote: The meal penalty and overtime rules alone saved me a disputed timecard on my last commercial. It calculated it before the crew even asked.
testimonials.name: Marcus Vell

pricing.blurb: For the one-person shoot paying a small handful of crew.
For features and commercials with a full crew and real pay rules.
For studios and prod companies running back-to-back projects.

homepage.footerBlurb: Salaria is payroll for people who make things, not spreadsheets. Timecards, taxes, and payouts for the crew you actually hired.
